# CBDB-Desktop: Texts (Look At Texts) label revisions, 2026-10-28

Eleventh and last form with FormLabels rows in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access table (form code LAT, 31 rows in the updated 643-row table). Changes are in the Texts form's index.html only; no back-end or stylesheet change was needed. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom): all 33 labels written by setLanguage were compared with their translations in all three languages, and TXT-5 and TXT-6 were checked, with no script errors. **Not yet tested in the running app.** A copy of the file before these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html. TXT-1 to TXT-4 are in the report of 2026-10-16.

## How to revert a label

All labels are in the translations object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. Change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each line has a comment naming its FormLabels row (or "No row") and, where changed, the earlier wording. Where the English changed, the same text is also written in the HTML element; setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load.

## Notes

**LBL-112, LBL-113.** "CBDB: Look At Texts" / "CBDB: 查看文本", in place of the fixed "CBDB — Look At Texts / 查看文本". The Navigation link already read "← Navigation" in English only; it got id="lnkNavigation" and the navigation key.

**Fixed bilingual headings.** All four section headings were fixed text in both languages at once ("Text / 文本", "Query Mode / 查询模式", "People Address / 人物地址", "Date Filter / 日期筛选"), with the last two in simplified characters in every mode. They now have ids and keys and follow the language. People Address (人物地址) matches the Office form.

**LBL-114. Text section.** The box labels "English" and "中文" were fixed text; they now have keys (English / Chinese, 英文 / 中文) shared with the People Address section. **Select Text** keeps the HTML's wording (選擇文本), without the "…" that setLanguage added. LAT 4 is "Select Text Category" (選擇文本類別), but the texts picker selects individual texts as well as categories (TXT-4), so the table's wording would mislead; this follows the decision of 2026-10-28 to keep clearer HTML wording. The clear button read "All" (全部); it now reads **All Texts** (所有文本), on the pattern of All Places and All Dynasties. Its tooltip, which repeated "All" in English, was removed.

**LBL-115. Query Mode.** No rows. The Chinese now uses the table's terms for sources: Biographical Sources 傳記出處 (出處 as BIO 55, Sources), Main source only 僅主要出處 (SF_BSD 5, Main Source 主要出處), Self-biography only 僅本人傳記 (SF_BSD 4, Self-Biography 本人傳記). They replace 傳記資料來源, 僅主要來源 and 僅自傳. Text Roles (文本角色, as in LAT 10's 有文本角色的人) and Both (兩者) are unchanged; a stray space after "Both" in the markup was removed.

**LBL-116.** As on the other forms: Select Place 選擇地名, All Places 所有地名 (the button read "All"), Include Subordinate Units, Use XY References. The two checkboxes already had the enable-with-place behaviour (TXT-2). **Check the width** of their row.

**LBL-117.** The radio buttons were "No date filter", "Index year" (索引年份) and "Dynasty"; they now take LAT 26–28. From / To are 始年 / 終年 (LAT 1, 2). The Select Dynasties button had no id and stayed in English; it is now translated. The dynasty clear button and the dynasty summary shared the allDynasties key ("All"); the button now reads **All Dynasties** (LAT 24), and the summary's "All" moved to a new key, dynastyAll, as on Status.

**LBL-118.** As on the other forms: 查詢; 保存于KML, 保存于GIS (LAT 6), Save to Neo4j 保存于Neo4j (LAT 29, replacing "Export Neo4j" 導出Neo4j); Store Person IDs under the regional-usage rule; 匯出 in traditional.

**LBL-119. Tabs.** "Source Records" (資料來源記錄) becomes **Texts and Roles** (文本與人物角色, LAT 9), which also describes the Text Roles rows the tab shows in the Text Roles and Both modes. People becomes 有文本角色的人 (LAT 10), the pattern already used for the Status form's People tab. In the Biographical Sources mode the people listed are those with a biographical source rather than a text role in the strict sense; 有文本角色的人 was kept as the table's wording.

**Comment.** The comment above translations points to this report.

## TXT-5: Run Query hover text

updateRunQueryState() set Run Query's hover text to "Select at least one text or a place." in English whatever the language, and setLanguage did not refresh it. It now uses a new key, needTextOrPlace (請至少選擇一種文本或一個地名。), and setLanguage calls updateRunQueryState().

## TXT-6: All Texts and All Places enabled only with a selection

Both clear buttons were always enabled. Each now starts disabled, is enabled when its picker returns a selection, and is disabled again when clicked, as All Places is on Office, Places and Status. This uses the .btn-clear:disabled style added in CSS-3 (Places report).

**jsdom check.** On load: All Texts, All Places, the two place checkboxes and Run Query are disabled. After a text is picked, All Texts and Run Query are enabled. After a place is picked, All Places and the checkboxes are enabled. After both are cleared, all five are disabled again.

## Issues

1. **Untranslated text.** The box placeholders ((all texts), (全部文本), (all places), (全部地点), e.g. 600), the address-picker labels, "No results yet…", "N source record(s), N unique person(s).", and the status and error messages are English only, or fixed in one language.
1. **Results-table headers.** Hard-coded and mixed, as on the other forms (Title / 書名, Main Source, SelfBio, Role, Address / 地址 …).
1. **Unused request field.** exportGIS still sends encoding: 'unicode', which the back end does not read (open item from 2026-10-16).

- The Include Subordinate Units / Use XY References row and the tab bar.
